title: Area membership is split across two helpers: _area_targets (caster origin, Cone/Cube, with a Total Cover check) and _sphere_targets (Sphere at a point, no cover check). Each handler also hard-codes its size: _sleep passes 5 and _burning_hands passes 15, though SPELLS[...]['area'] already holds ('sphere', 5) and ('cone', 15). Merge them into one area-selection helper that takes the origin (caster or point) and reads shape and size from the spell's area data.

history.reason: part of the area targeting feature (T-56)
